cases.question: find the name of employee who was awarded the most times in the evaluation.
cases.query: SELECT t1.name FROM employee AS t1 JOIN evaluation AS t2 ON t1.Employee_ID  =  t2.Employee_ID GROUP BY t2.Employee_ID ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Find the name of the employee who got the highest one time bonus.
cases.query: SELECT t1.name FROM employee AS t1 JOIN evaluation AS t2 ON t1.Employee_ID  =  t2.Employee_ID ORDER BY t2.bonus DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the name of the shop that is hiring the largest number of employees?
cases.query: SELECT t2.name FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id GROUP BY t1.shop_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Show names of teachers that teach at least two courses.
cases.query: SELECT T2.Name FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2

cases.question: What is the total ticket expense of the visitors whose membership level is 1?
cases.query: SELECT sum(t2.Total_spent) FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id WHERE t1.Level_of_membership  =  1

cases.question: What is the name of the visitor who visited both a museum opened before 2009 and a museum opened after 2011?
cases.query: SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year  <  2009 INTERSECT SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year  >  2011

cases.question: What is the birth date of the poker player with the lowest earnings?
cases.query: SELECT T1.Birth_Date FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID ORDER BY T2.Earnings ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the money rank of the tallest poker player?
cases.query: SELECT T2.Money_Rank FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID ORDER BY T1.Height DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average earnings of poker players with height higher than 200?
cases.query: SELECT avg(T2.Earnings) FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID WHERE T1.Height  >  200

cases.question: What is the name of the high schooler who has the greatest number of friends?
cases.query: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Show the names of high schoolers who have at least 3 friends.
cases.query: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  3

cases.question: Show the names of all of the high schooler Kyle's friends.
cases.query: SELECT T3.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id JOIN Highschooler AS T3 ON T1.friend_id  =  T3.id WHERE T2.name  =  "Kyle"
